packageRules.description: flake.nix keys tailnet's vendored modules on vendorHash. Renovate rewrites it in its own commit with the go-vendor-hash helper, which builds with a fake hash so stale modules in a cache cannot pass. One weekly PR. tailnet/e2e replaces tailnet with ../, so a dependency both share (tailscale.com) must move in both go.mod files at once. The command must match RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS on the runner.
Workflows hold the release signing keys: their updates are reviewed, never merged automatically.
The flake takes Rust from rust-overlay at rust-toolchain.toml's version. Wait until the daily flake.lock maintenance has locked an overlay that knows the release.
The Linux builds' ubuntu container (static musl builds of thurm and thurmd) is the same image in CI and Release, so their caches match. Move both by hand, together.
The end-to-end job's Playwright container must carry the browsers of the @playwright/test version in web/package.json: bump both in one PR.
